hero.title: Tailored solutions for your vehicles and energy
hero.subtitle: NJIWA assists you with used vehicle imports, solar system installation, GPS tracking and fuel control. Reliable services designed for Africa.

about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: A trusted partner at your service
about.description: NJIWA is a company that offers a wide range of services to both the general public and businesses. It focuses primarily on the sale of used vehicles imported from around the world, installation of solar systems, drilling water wells in communities and businesses, studies and implementation of environmental systems, installation of GPS systems as well as fuel control on motorized and static vehicles.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: Our mission is to provide you with vehicles, electricity, water and ensure the security of your vehicles while protecting the environment. All our work is conducted in a manner that produces complete satisfaction. We are very attentive to your concerns in order to improve our standards so that your satisfaction is total. Your concerns and suggestions mean a great deal to us. With your support and guidance, we provide quality service at very competitive prices compared to the competition.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.description: We aim to ensure the visibility of our company through quality service rendered to our valued clientele. Through our seriousness, quality, and availability we will be able to have NJIWA spoken of in great African forums. To be a reference in one or more of the fields in which we operate. We are very confident that our customers' satisfaction will open all doors for us.

values.title: Reliability
values.description: Our work is conducted not through trial and error, but with conviction. With the strong experience we have in the various fields, our work is executed in respect of standards and materials selected for high quality. And quality controls accompany all stages of the realization of our various tasks.

values.title: Transparency
values.description: We communicate in a very simple and open manner with our clients so that we arrive at what they want. We explicitly outline all tasks, costs and timing in order to keep us away from unpleasantness.

values.title: Innovation
values.description: We execute our clients' work using our vast experience in order to delight them beyond their expectations. Such is our state of mind when we render services.

values.title: Client Engagement
values.description: Your satisfaction is our priority. That is why we do not abandon you. We are with you before, during and after the project so that your satisfaction is complete.

services.title: Our Services
services.subtitle: Complete solutions for your vehicles, water drilling, environmental projects and energy

items.title: Solar energy systems
items.description: We design and install customized solar systems for residential, commercial and remote sites. Reduce your dependence on the electrical grid and control your energy costs with clean, renewable energy.
features: Technical study and personalized dimensioning
High-performance solar panels and certified inverters
Residential, commercial and industrial solutions
Autonomous or hybrid systems with battery storage
Preventive maintenance and technical support after installation

items.title: Water well drilling
items.description: We execute water wells serving different purposes in different environments. We conduct in-depth studies to execute wells of good quality capable of meeting your expectations exactly. According to the objectives of your wells, we observe safety, hygiene and environmental recommendations to your complete satisfaction. We operate in community spaces as well as in industry in general. According to your aspirations, water quality analyses can be provided as needed.
features: In-depth studies for high-quality wells
Compliance with safety, hygiene and environmental standards
Intervention in community and industrial spaces
Water quality analyses available on request
Multi-environment expertise: domestic, industrial and agricultural water

items.title: Used vehicle imports
items.description: We import carefully selected used vehicles from Japan, the United States, the United Kingdom and Europe. Each vehicle undergoes thorough mechanical inspection before shipment to ensure you a safe purchase.
features: Inspected and certified vehicles before shipment
Wide selection: sedans, SUVs, pick-ups, commercial vehicles and trucks
Import from Japan, USA, London and Europe
Complete support: selection, transit, customs clearance and delivery
Competitive prices and flexible payment terms

items.title: Sale of rare automobile parts
items.description: As part of providing even more support to our valued clients, we sell parts that are not easily found on our local market. We work with a very competent service to research quality parts that we order from all over the world.
features: Sourcing rare and hard-to-find parts locally
Global network of trusted suppliers
Quality guarantee on all ordered parts
Fast and reliable delivery times
Technical support for installation and maintenance

items.title: Vehicle GPS tracking
items.description: Take full control of your fleet with our real-time geolocation systems. Our GPS technology allows you to track your vehicles, optimize routes and strengthen the security of your assets.
features: Real-time location on interactive map
Detailed history of routes and stops
Configurable alerts: overspeed, forbidden zones, unauthorized startup
Dashboard accessible from computer and smartphone
Discreet installation compatible with all types of vehicles

items.title: Fuel monitoring and management
items.description: Eliminate fuel losses and optimize your consumption with our advanced monitoring solutions. Our high-precision sensors detect anomalies in real time, whether on your vehicles or storage tanks.
features: High-precision fuel level sensors
Instant detection of theft and leaks
Monitoring of fixed tanks and vehicle reservoirs
Detailed consumption reports and automatic alerts
Integration with GPS systems for unified fleet management

items.title: Environmental work
items.description: This century of strong industrialization brings us many activities, several of which are of a nature that can destroy the environment and thus break the balance of ecosystems. We provide you with in-depth studies of your production activities to propose adequate modes of operation capable of minimizing as much as possible the impact on the environment according to universally accepted standards. We implement appropriate solutions while guaranteeing healthy production. In summary, we take you in charge from conception to the disposal of all types of waste.
features: Environmental impact studies of your production activities
Operating modes adapted to minimize ecological impact
Solutions compliant with universal environmental standards
Complete waste management: from design to disposal
Guarantee of healthy and sustainable production
